name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
scale: 1,120个场景（800个核心场景 + 320个增强场景）
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against the main Gaia2 paper arXiv:2602.11964v1, official repository revision 7946367413129784139e785ae4c351090002a0bb, and official Hugging Face dataset revision 78ea3bdbdeec2bdcd6afa5420915d8a22f23ed99. The dataset card still links arXiv:2509.17158v2, an older ARE paper and not the main Gaia2 paper used here. Its prose also says mini has 200 scenarios, but the pinned metadata and main paper both specify 160, which is the value used here. The paper builds ARE Mobile with 12 apps, 101 tools, 10 coherent universes, and 400K–800K tokens per universe. Humans author initial state, oracle write actions, and environment events in scenario DAGs; independent validation, consistency checks, graph guardrails, and baseline-agent calibration produce 800 unique core scenarios across five capability splits, 160 each, plus a 160-item Gaia2-mini subset. Noise 160 and Agent2Agent 160 are environment modifiers derived from mini that reuse write annotations, yielding 800 core + 320 derived evaluation scenarios = 1,120. The pinned public dataset exposes five core configs of 160 = 800, mini 160, and demo 3; the official evaluation derives the two augmentations, the test set is private, and the public leaderboard uses validation. The ReAct-like scaffold issues one JSON tool call per step at temperature 0.5 with 16K output tokens per turn, three runs, and at most 200 steps. The minimal-oracle verifier ignores read exploration and checks rigid arguments exactly, flexible text with an LLM rubric, and consistency, causality, timing, and completeness. On 450 hand-labeled trajectories it reports 0.98 agreement, 0.99 precision, and 0.95 recall. The primary metric is Pass@1 by split and overall.
